name: swissprot
title: UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot (all domains, protein)
description: Curated Swiss-Prot proteins from all domains of life, with NCBI taxonomy. Reads are translated and matched at the protein level. Broad but sparse (mostly well-studied organisms), so calls below phylum or family are reliable only for well-studied taxa. Large: plan for about 1 GB of browser memory.
